Why Zenra AI

## Why choose Zenra AI

Agency-grade quality, delivered in days, with clear communication and one point of contact from the first call to launch.

- **AI-first, not AI-everything.** We use AI where it clearly saves time or money, and plain, reliable software everywhere else.
- **Product-company habits.** We ship and support our own apps, so we plan for users, updates and support from day one.
- **No hand-offs.** Strategy, design, development and support in one team, with one point of contact.
- **Security by default.** Least-privilege access, no shared passwords, secrets kept out of code and an NDA whenever you need one.
- **Built to hand over.** Clean, documented work in your own accounts, so any capable developer can continue it.
- **Worldwide, on your time.** Clients around the world, in English, with calls scheduled around your time zone.

Process

## How every project runs

A clear path from the first call to launch, with something you can see and test within days.

1. **Discovery call.** A free 30-minute call about your goals, your users and what success looks like. No obligation. Notes and a recommended next step
2. **Proposal and fixed quote.** Scope, milestones, timeline and price in writing. Work starts only when you approve it. A written proposal you can share
3. **Design and prototype.** Designs or a working prototype first, so you can judge the direction before the full build. Designs or a prototype to review
4. **Build fast, with live previews.** Short milestones, progress updates and a working preview link. Most projects are delivered within days. A live preview link while we build
5. **Launch and improve.** We launch, hand over every login and document, and stay on for support and improvements. A handover pack and post-launch support

Ways to work together

## Ways to work together

Pick the model that fits the work. You can start with a project and move to a monthly plan after launch.

### Fixed-scope project

A defined build with one price, paid by milestone.

**Best for:** a new website, web app, store, AI tool or AI agent.

**Billing:** deposit to start, then by milestone.

### Monthly retainer

An agreed amount of work every month, on flexible terms.

**Best for:** store management, agent improvements and new features.

**Billing:** monthly, agreed in advance.

### Support and maintenance

Updates, backups, monitoring and small fixes, so everything keeps running.

**Best for:** systems we built or ones you already have.

**Billing:** a simple monthly plan.

FAQ

## Questions clients ask first

Something else on your mind? [Ask us directly](https://zenraai.com/contact/). We reply within one business day.

#### How much does a project cost?

It depends on your budget and on what you want to build. Start by [filling in the project form](https://zenraai.com/contact/) and sharing your idea. A few lines are enough. We'll reply with a free estimate within one business day, and after a short chat you get a fixed quote in writing, split into milestones, before any work starts.

#### How long does a project take?

Not long. Most projects (a website, an online store, an AI tool or a first version of your app) are delivered within a few days. Bigger projects usually take about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start, and it's written into your proposal.

#### Do you build mobile and desktop apps?

Yes. We build Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android apps with installers, licensing, payments, automatic updates and the App Store and Google Play launch. See [desktop and mobile app development](https://zenraai.com/services/app-development/).

#### Do you work with clients in my country?

Yes. We work remotely with clients around the world, in English, and schedule calls around your time zone.

#### Who owns the work when it's finished?

You do. Once the project is paid, the code, designs and content are yours. Domains, hosting, stores and AI accounts are set up in your name from the start.

#### Will you sign an NDA?

Yes. We're happy to sign a mutual NDA before you share confidential details.

#### How do we stay in touch during a project?

By email, WhatsApp or video call, whatever suits you, plus short progress updates and a link to the latest working version while we build.

#### How do payments work?

Usually a deposit to start and the rest by milestone. We agree on an international payment method that works for you, and the details are in your proposal.

#### What happens after launch?

We hand over every login, file and document, fix anything that isn't working as agreed, and offer optional monthly support, improvements and new features.

Title: About Us, an AI and Software Development Company | Zenra AI
Description: Zenra AI is an AI and software development company that builds AI agents, custom AI tools, websites, online stores and Windows, Mac and mobile apps worldwide.

# About Zenra AI

Zenra AI is an AI and software development company. We build AI agents, custom AI tools, websites, web apps, online stores and Windows, Mac and mobile apps for businesses around the world. We also make our own apps for creators.

Most businesses don't need more software. They need the right software, built well, explained clearly and owned by them.

That's why Zenra AI exists. We start by understanding the problem, build only what helps, and make sure you own, and can run, everything we deliver.

We began by building our own products, including a video downloader, a video splitter and an AI app that turns long videos into short clips. Shipping software to customers (with licensing, payments, automatic updates and support) taught us what makes technology work outside a demo.

Today we bring the same discipline to client work. Strategy, design, development and support sit with one team, so you get one plan, one point of contact and people who care whether the project works long after launch.

## Zenra AI in brief

The short version for new clients, partners, journalists and AI assistants.

## Key facts

- Company: Zenra AI, an AI and software development company
- Where we work: Worldwide, in English, across time zones
- Services: AI agents, custom AI tools and chatbots, websites and web apps, online stores, and desktop and mobile apps
- Our products: [Zenra AI Agent](https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/), Zenra Video Downloader, Zenra AI Viral Clips and Zenra Video Splitter
- How we work: Fixed quotes in US dollars, paid by milestone, with most projects delivered within days
- Contact: support@zenraai.com

## What we believe

Six principles that shape every project, from a landing page to an AI system.

- **Build only what helps.** We'll tell you when something isn't worth building, even if it means a smaller project for us.
- **Show, don't tell.** Working software beats long reports. You see real progress within days and judge it with your own eyes.
- **Honest by default.** Fixed quotes, realistic timelines and straight answers, including the ones you'd rather not hear.
- **Your business, your ownership.** Code, accounts and data belong to you from day one. No lock-in.
- **Security is not optional.** Careful access, no shared passwords and safe defaults on every project.
- **Always learning.** AI moves fast. We test new tools on our own products first, so you get what works, not what's hyped.

### Global delivery

We work with clients around the world, across time zones.

### English, on your time

Written updates while we build and calls on your time zone.

### Fixed quotes in USD

One clear price for defined work, paid by milestone.

### Products we run

Zenra AI Agent and three Windows apps, designed, shipped and supported by our own team.

We work in writing and around your time zone, with a fixed quote before we start and delivery in days, not months.

- **One team, idea to launch.** No hand-offs between agencies. The people who plan your project build, launch and improve it.
- **Product-company habits.** We plan for users, updates and support from day one, because we run our own apps.
- **Secure access.** We ask only for the access we need, never share passwords and hand everything back at the end.
- **Plain English.** Clear explanations, no jargon, and a reply within one business day.

Title: How We Work, From Free Estimate to Launch | Zenra AI
Description: How Zenra AI runs projects, from a free discovery call and fixed quote to delivery in days, live previews, milestone payments, security, ownership and support.

# How we work

A calm, predictable process from the first call to launch and beyond. You always know what's being built, what it costs and what happens next.

- Free discovery call
- Fixed quote in writing
- Delivered in days
- You own everything

## Five steps, no surprises

Every project follows the same path, whatever its size.

1. **Discovery call.** A free 30-minute call about your goals, users, timeline and budget. No obligation. Notes and a recommended next step
2. **Proposal and fixed quote.** A written proposal with scope, milestones, delivery date, price and what we need from you. Work starts only when you approve it. A proposal you can share with your team
3. **Design and prototype.** Designs, a clickable prototype or a working proof of concept, so you can judge the direction before the full build. Designs or a prototype to review
4. **Build fast, with live previews.** We build in short milestones and send progress updates with a link to the latest working version. Most projects are delivered within days. A live preview link while we build
5. **Launch and support.** We launch, hand over every login, file and document, and fix anything that isn't working as agreed. A handover pack and post-launch support

## What you can expect while we build

Communication is the part clients remember. Ours is written down, regular and easy to follow.

- **Short written updates.** What we finished, what's next and anything we need from you, in a few clear lines.
- **A live preview link.** Click through the real, working version. No screenshots, no waiting for the end.
- **One point of contact.** One person who knows your project end to end and answers your questions.
- **Replies within one business day.** By email or WhatsApp, and faster when something is urgent.
- **Calls on your time zone.** Short video calls for demos and decisions, scheduled when it suits you.
- **Decisions on record.** Scope, changes and approvals written down, so nothing gets lost.

## Ways to work together

Fixed-price projects for defined builds, and monthly options for ongoing work.

### Fixed-scope project

A defined build with one price, paid by milestone.

**Best for:** a new website, web app, store, AI tool or AI agent.

**Billing:** deposit to start, then by milestone.

### Monthly retainer

An agreed amount of work every month, on flexible terms.

**Best for:** store management, agent improvements and new features.

**Billing:** monthly, agreed in advance.

### Support and maintenance

Updates, backups, monitoring and small fixes, so everything keeps running.

**Best for:** systems we built or ones you already have.

**Billing:** a simple monthly plan.

## Clear pricing, paid in milestones

You know the full price before we start, and you pay as approved work is delivered.

- A fixed price for the agreed scope
- Usually a deposit to start, then payment by milestone
- Changes outside the scope are quoted before we do them
- International payment options agreed in your proposal
- Hosting, platform subscriptions and AI usage paid by you directly and never marked up

## Quality and security

The habits that keep your project safe, built into how we work and not added at the end.

- **Version control.** All code lives in Git, in a repository you own, with a clear history of every change.
- **Testing before release.** Features are tested on a preview or staging version before anything reaches your customers.
- **Least-privilege access.** We ask only for the access we need, and you can remove it at any time.
- **No shared passwords.** Accounts are created in your name, and secrets stay in secure settings, never in code.
- **Backups.** Backups and a rollback plan for websites, stores and databases we run.
- **NDA on request.** We're happy to sign a mutual NDA before you share confidential details.

## Everything is yours

When the project is paid, you own the work and you can run it without us.

- Source code in your own repository
- Domains, hosting, stores and AI accounts in your name from day one
- Design files and the content we created
- Documentation and a recorded or live handover session
- Admin access transferred and our access removed whenever you ask

## Questions about working with us

Can't find your answer? [Send us your question](https://zenraai.com/contact/). We reply within one business day.

#### Do I need a detailed brief?

No. A few sentences, a budget range and a couple of examples you like are enough. The discovery call fills in the rest, and we write the detailed scope for you to approve.

#### Can we change the scope during the project?

Yes. Small adjustments are part of normal work. Bigger changes are quoted in writing before we do them, so the price never changes by surprise.

#### What do you need from us?

A main contact who can make decisions, quick feedback on the previews we share, and the content and access listed in your proposal. We tell you exactly what we need and when.

#### How fast do you deliver?

Fast. Most projects are delivered within a few days, and bigger projects usually take about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start, and it's written into your proposal.

#### Which time zone do you work in?

We work remotely with clients worldwide and plan calls around your time zone. Most communication is written, so you always have a record of decisions.

#### What if we're not happy with the work?

You see progress as we build, so problems surface early and are fixed early. Payments follow approved milestones, and we'll always tell you plainly if something isn't working.

#### Do you offer support after launch?

Yes. We fix anything that doesn't work as agreed, and you can choose a monthly support, maintenance or improvement plan if you want us to stay on.

## Tell us what you're building

Share a few details about your project. We reply within one business day with questions or next steps, and there is no obligation.

# AI agent development

AI agents that do real work across your apps (answering customers, replying to leads, updating records and preparing reports) with clear limits, approval for anything important, and a person one click away.

- Fixed quote before we start
- Delivered in days
- You own everything

## At a glance

- Delivery: Most agents in a few days and bigger builds in about 5 to 6 days
- Pricing: A free estimate, then a fixed quote paid by milestone
- You receive: A working agent, admin controls, logs, documentation and training
- Built-in safety: Approvals, human handoff, audit logs and a stop switch

## Is this for you?

AI agent development means building software that uses an AI model to understand a request, decide the next step and act in your tools, within limits you set. It is a good fit when one of these sounds familiar.

- Your team answers the same questions all day
- New leads wait hours for a first reply
- People copy data between inboxes, apps and spreadsheets
- Weekly reports take hours to put together

## What we build

From one agent that does one job well to a team of agents that work together, always with clear limits.

### Customer support agents

Answer questions from your help center, policies and order data on your website, WhatsApp or email, and hand off to a person when needed.

### Sales and lead agents

Reply to new leads in seconds, ask qualifying questions, book calls and keep your CRM up to date.

### Operations agents

Process invoices, orders and forms, update records across your apps and flag anything unusual for review.

### Research and reporting agents

Collect data from your tools and the web, then write the weekly report, summary or brief for you.

### Voice agents

Answer and route calls, book appointments and take messages, with natural speech and a summary of every call.

### Browser agents

Work in websites and portals with no API to fill in forms, check statuses and download files.

### Multi-agent systems

Specialized agents that plan, check and hand work to each other for longer, multi-step jobs.

### Integrations and MCP

Connect agents to your CRM, help desk, store, email and databases through APIs, webhooks and the Model Context Protocol.

### Monitoring and improvement

Dashboards for quality, speed and cost, test sets that catch problems early, and regular tuning.

## Agents you can trust with real work

An agent is only useful if it's safe to let it act. These controls are built into every agent we ship.

- **Three levels of autonomy.** Agents act alone on safe tasks, ask before anything important, and never touch what's off-limits. You set the rules.
- **Least-privilege access.** Each agent gets only the tools and data its job needs, with separate keys you can revoke at any time.
- **A person in the loop.** Uncertain cases and high-impact actions go to your team for approval, with the context to decide quickly.
- **Tested before launch.** Every agent is tested on real cases from your business, including the tricky ones, before it goes live.
- **Every step logged.** See what the agent read, decided and did, so any answer can be checked and corrected.
- **Predictable running costs.** The right-sized model for each step, caching and usage limits keep the cost per task low and capped.

## Chatbot, automation or AI agent?

Three different tools for three different jobs. We'll recommend the simplest one that works for you.

| Compared | Chatbot | Automation | AI agent |
|---|---|---|---|
| What it does | Answers questions | Runs fixed steps between apps | Works through a task and takes actions |
| Handles new situations | Within its knowledge | No, only the rules it was given | Yes, within the limits you set |
| Uses your apps | Rarely | Yes, in a fixed order | Yes, choosing the right tool each time |
| Best for | FAQs and simple support | Predictable, repeated workflows | Varied work that needs judgment |

Read our full guide on [AI agent vs chatbot and which one your business needs](https://zenraai.com/blog/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/).

2. **Design the agent.** Tools, data, permissions, approval rules and when to hand off to a person, all written down before we build. An agent design you approve
3. **Prototype and test.** A working agent in a safe sandbox, tested on real examples from your business, including the tricky ones. Test results on your own cases
4. **Pilot with approvals.** The agent works alongside your team, and important actions wait for a person to approve them. A live pilot with full logs
5. **Launch and improve.** Full rollout, monitoring of quality and cost, and regular tuning as your business changes. Dashboards, documentation and support

## Common questions

Answers about AI agent development. Can't find yours? [Send us your question](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=ai-agents) or read our guide on [AI agents vs chatbots](https://zenraai.com/blog/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/).

#### What is an AI agent?

An AI agent is software that uses an AI model to work through a task step by step and take actions with tools, for example reading a support message, checking the order in your store and sending the reply. A simple chatbot only answers, while an agent can also act.

#### How is an agent different from automation tools like Zapier or n8n?

Automation follows fixed rules. An agent can read messy input, decide what to do and handle cases nobody wrote a rule for. We often combine both, using automation for the predictable steps and an agent for the judgment calls.

#### Will the agent make mistakes?

Sometimes, like any new team member, so we design for it. Agents get narrow permissions, important actions need approval, uncertain cases go to a person, and every step is logged so it can be checked and improved.

#### Is our data safe?

Agents only get the access their job needs. We use AI providers that don't train on your API data, keep keys and secrets out of the code, and can run models on your own servers when privacy requires it.

#### Which apps can the agent work with?

Most tools with an API (CRMs, help desks, online stores, email, calendars, spreadsheets and databases) and websites without an API through browser automation. We confirm every integration during discovery.

#### How much does an AI agent cost?

It depends on your budget and the job you want the agent to do, such as how many apps it connects to and how much it handles on its own. Start by [filling in the project form](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=ai-agents) and sharing your idea, even if it's rough. We'll reply with a free estimate, and after a short chat you get a fixed quote before any work starts. AI usage is billed to your own AI account, and we estimate it upfront.

#### How long does it take?

Fast. Most agents are ready within a few days. A bigger agent with several integrations, approvals and monitoring usually takes about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start.

#### Can one agent work on our website and WhatsApp?

Yes. The same agent can answer on your website chat, WhatsApp and email, using one shared knowledge base and handing conversations to your team when needed.

#### Do you have a ready-made AI agent?

Yes. [Zenra AI Agent](https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/) is our ready-made AI chat agent for websites. It answers customers 24/7 in their language, saves leads and hands chats to your team, and it can be live on your site quickly. See all of our ready-made agents on the [AI agents](https://zenraai.com/agents/) page.

#### Do you work with small businesses?

Yes. Small teams are a great fit. We usually start with one agent for one clear job, like answering common customer questions or replying to new leads, so you see results before investing more.

## How we approach AI projects

AI is only useful when it fits the work. These rules keep projects practical, measurable and affordable.

- **Start with the workflow.** We map the task, measure how long it takes today and decide where AI genuinely helps, and where plain software is better.
- **Prove it on your data.** A small working prototype on real examples comes before the full build, so you can judge quality early.
- **Choose the right model.** We compare OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and open-source models on quality, speed, cost and privacy, and keep them swappable.
- **Keep people in control.** Confidence checks, review steps and clear logs for anything that affects your customers or your money.
- **Keep running costs predictable.** Caching, batching and smart model routing keep the cost per task low and easy to forecast.
- **Protect your data.** Least-privilege access, encrypted secrets and providers that don't train on your data, or models on your own servers.

#### What's the difference between an AI tool and an AI agent?

An AI tool does one job when you use it, like extracting data from an invoice or answering a question from your documents. An AI agent works through multi-step tasks and takes actions across your apps on its own. Many projects start with a tool and grow into an agent.

#### Is our data safe?

## Shopify or WooCommerce?

Both are popular, proven platforms. Here's how they differ, and we'll recommend the one that fits your products, budget and team.

| Compared | Shopify | WooCommerce |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | An all-in-one, hosted store platform | A free plugin that turns a WordPress site into a store |
| Hosting and security | Included and handled by Shopify | Your own hosting, kept updated by you or your developer |
| Running costs | A monthly Shopify plan, plus paid apps and payment fees | Hosting and domain, plus paid extensions and payment fees |
| Ease of use | The easiest to run day to day | More flexible, with a little more upkeep |
| Best for | Most brands that want to start selling fast | Brands that want full control or already use WordPress |

Read our full guide on [Shopify vs WooCommerce and which is better for your store](https://zenraai.com/blog/shopify-vs-woocommerce/).

2. **Design.** A store design that fits your brand and makes products easy to buy on a phone. Store designs to review
3. **Build and catalog.** Theme, apps, products, collections and content, built in a preview store you can click through. A preview store with your products
4. **Test and launch.** Test orders through every payment method, shipping rule and email before going live. A launched store and training
5. **Manage and grow.** Optional monthly management, improvements and new features. A monthly sales and conversion report

#### Is Shopify or WooCommerce better for me?

Shopify is the easiest to run and scales smoothly, which makes it ideal for most brands. WooCommerce gives more control and can cost less to run if you're comfortable with WordPress. We recommend one in your proposal based on your products, budget and team.

#### How much does an online store cost?

It depends on your budget and on your store, including the number of products, the design and the integrations. #### How long does it take?

Fast. A new store is usually ready within a few days. Bigger stores and migrations usually take about 5 to 6 days, depending on catalog size and integrations. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start.

#### Can you migrate my store without losing SEO?

Yes. We move products, customers and orders, keep URLs or redirect them, and carry over titles and descriptions so your rankings are protected.

#### Who owns the store?

You do. The store, domain and payment accounts are created in your name from day one.

## Cross-platform or native?

Two ways to build an app. We recommend the one that fits your users, your budget and how fast you need to launch.

| Compared | Cross-platform | Native |
|---|---|---|
| Built with | Flutter, React Native, Electron or Tauri | Swift for Apple, Kotlin for Android, C# or C++ for Windows |
| One codebase for | iPhone and Android, or Windows and Mac | One platform at a time |
| Cost and time | Lower, because most of the work is shared | Higher, because each platform is built separately |
| Best for | Most business apps and internal tools | Apps that need top speed or deep device features |

Deciding between a desktop app and a web app? Read [Desktop app vs web app and how to choose](https://zenraai.com/blog/desktop-app-vs-web-app/)

Clear stages, a fixed quote and a working preview while we build. Most projects are delivered within days.

2. **Design.** Screens and flows designed for each platform, so the app feels at home on Windows, Mac or a phone. Designs you can click through
3. **Build with test builds.** We build fast, in short milestones, and send test versions you can install and try as we go. Test builds while we build
4. **Test, package and launch.** Tested on real devices, packaged as installers or store builds, signed where needed and published. A launched app and a handover session
5. **Updates and support.** Automatic updates, crash monitoring, fixes and new features after launch. A support plan that fits

## Common questions

Answers about app development. Can't find yours? [Send us your question](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=apps) or read our guide on [desktop apps vs web apps](https://zenraai.com/blog/desktop-app-vs-web-app/).

#### Which platforms can you build for?

Windows, macOS, iPhone (iOS) and Android. Many apps can share one codebase across platforms. When speed or a native feel matters most, we build natively. We recommend the best approach in your proposal.

#### How long does it take to build an app?

Fast. Most apps are delivered within a few days, and bigger apps usually take about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. Mobile apps also go through App Store and Google Play review, which Apple and Google control and which usually takes from a day to a few days. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start.

#### How much does an app cost?

It depends on your budget and on your app, including the platforms, the features and the integrations. Start by [filling in the project form](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=apps) and sharing your idea, even if it's rough. We'll reply with a free estimate, and after a short chat you get a fixed quote before any work starts. Developer accounts and store fees are paid by you directly.

#### Can you publish the app on the App Store and Google Play?

Yes. We prepare the store listing, screenshots and privacy details and handle the submission. The app is published under your own developer account, so it stays yours.

#### Can the app update itself?

Yes. Desktop apps get one-click automatic updates, the same approach our own Windows apps use. Mobile apps update through the App Store and Google Play.

#### Can you add licensing, subscriptions or in-app purchases?

Yes. We set up free trials, license keys, subscriptions and in-app purchases, connected to the payment method that suits your business and each store's rules.

#### Can you turn our website or Windows app into a Mac or mobile app?

Often, yes. We review what you already have and reuse as much as possible (the logic, the design or the backend) so the new app costs less and stays consistent.

#### Who owns the app and the code?

You do. The source code is in your repository, and the store accounts, signing certificates and backend are in your name.

## Everything a great front desk does

Fast, complete and polite answers, every hour of the day, without missing a single customer.

English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, Hindi, Arabic and more. It always replies in the language the customer writes in.

When someone asks for a person, or a question needs you, the chat goes to your team and the customer gets WhatsApp and email buttons.

It answers from your information, never makes up prices, keeps private details out of the chat and stays polite with tricky questions.

### Gets better every week

Questions it couldn't answer are listed for you. Answer once and it's fixed for every customer, in every language.

Get a notification the moment someone becomes a lead or asks for a person, so you can reply while they're still interested.

### Your name, your look

Choose its name, colours, greeting, quick buttons and position, so it feels like part of your own website.

## Up and running in an afternoon

Four simple steps in one easy app. No coding and no server to manage.

1. **Add your business info.** Your business name, what you sell, your contact details and the facts it must always get right.
2. **Teach it.** Let it read your website, upload your files or paste text. Test it like a customer and teach it a better answer whenever one isn't right.
3. **Go live.** Publish it on free Cloudflare hosting in about a minute. It keeps answering even when your computer is off.
4. **Add it to your website.** Paste one line of code on your site, or share your chat link and QR code if you don't have a website.

## Frequently asked questions

Something else? Email us at support@zenraai.com.

#### What is Zenra AI Agent?

A ready-made AI chat agent for your business. It answers customer questions on your website or on a chat link you share, day and night. It saves every lead and passes the chat to your team when a person is needed.

#### Do I need a website?

No. After you go live you get a chat link and a QR code. Put the link in your Instagram, TikTok and Facebook bio, your WhatsApp status and your Google Business profile, and print the QR code on menus, flyers and your counter.

#### Which website platforms does it work with?

It works with all of them, including WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Blogger, Hostinger, GoDaddy, Google Sites and any HTML website. You paste one line of code and the chat bubble appears on every page. The app shows the exact steps for each platform.

#### Does my computer need to stay on?

No. Once it's live, the agent runs in the cloud on free Cloudflare hosting and answers customers all day and night. Open the app whenever you like to see new chats and leads. They come in by themselves.

#### How do I train it?

Add your business info, let it read your website, upload files (PDF, Word, CSV or text) or paste text. Short facts like prices, opening hours and delivery go into **Key facts**, which it keeps in mind for every answer. If an answer isn't right, you teach it a better one and it's fixed for every customer.

#### Which languages does it speak?

It replies in the language your customer writes in, including English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, Hindi and Arabic.

#### What happens when a customer wants a real person?

The agent passes the chat to your team and shows WhatsApp and email buttons to the customer. You can get a phone alert the moment it happens.

#### Can it give my prices?

Yes, if you want it to. In **Rules** you choose whether it may share prices. It only quotes prices from your own information and never makes up a number.

#### Are there monthly costs for AI or hosting?

It can run at no cost, because it works with free AI keys (the app shows you how to get one in a minute) and free Cloudflare hosting. You can add paid AI keys any time for even faster replies.

#### Which computer do I need?

The Zenra AI Agent app, where you set up, train and see your chats, runs on Windows 10 and 11. Your customers can chat from any phone, tablet or computer.

#### How do I get Zenra AI Agent?

Tap **Get Zenra AI Agent** on this page or email us at support@zenraai.com. We'll answer your questions and help you get it running on your website.

For bookings, order tracking, internal tools or work across several apps, our team builds custom AI agents with approvals for anything important.

## How it works

# Zenra AI Viral Clips

Turn long videos into viral clips automatically

Zenra AI Viral Clips is a Windows app that cuts long videos into short clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. Add a podcast, interview, vlog or sports video. The AI finds the strong moments, keeps the speaker or the action in frame, adds word-by-word captions and a title, and saves every clip in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, up to 4K.

## A professional editor inside your PC

Everything an editor does to make a clip work, done for you, clip after clip.

### Finds every viral moment

The AI reads your whole video like an editor (a strong hook, a complete story, a payoff) and makes a clip of each moment. Longer videos give more clips, and your best clip is always #01.

### Clean starts and endings

Clips start with the question and end when the answer is finished, never on a cut-off word. Intros, sponsor reads and “thanks for watching” outros are left out.

### Follows whoever is talking

Speaker detection watches lips and listens to voices, so the frame stays on the person talking and cuts the moment someone else speaks, like a real editor.

### Split screen for conversations

When two people go back and forth, you see both, one on top and one below. Panels with three or four people stay lively instead of one long monologue.

### Follows the action

In sports and vlogs the whole person stays in view. After a shot the frame moves with the ball when it can be seen, so the clip shows where it went. What a vlogger holds up stays in frame too.

### Every clip size

9:16 for Shorts, Reels and TikTok. 4:5 and 1:1 for feed posts. 16:9 for YouTube, X and LinkedIn. Choose the size before you make the clips and the framing fits it.

### Scorecards stay on the clip

Golf scorecards and other score graphics are kept on screen when the picture is cropped, and they never cover a face.

### Videos without talking

Golf ASMR, silent vlogs and music videos get clips built around the action, like the sound of the hit and the camera cuts. No made-up captions.

### Word-by-word captions

Each word lights up as it's spoken. Eight styles, words always in the right order, and no “um” or “uh”.

### Titles, hashtags and a hook title

Every clip gets a title and hashtags. Files are named **Title - 01.mp4**, and one click copies the title for posting. Turn on the hook title and the title also shows at the top of the clip, in one of three looks.

### Up to 4K quality

Original, 4K, 2K or 1080p. Intel, NVIDIA and AMD graphics speed up the final videos automatically.

### Your logo on every clip

Add your logo once and it sits small and soft in the top-left corner of every clip, like a TV channel logo. No Zenra watermark.

### Same clips, or new ones

Run a video again and get the same clips instantly. That is handy for changing captions, logo, size or quality. **New clips** finds only moments you haven't made yet.

### 13 languages plus auto detect

English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi and Indonesian.

### Free AI built in, more if you want

Runs on a free Groq key. You can add another free key (Gemini, Cerebras, Mistral or OpenRouter free models) or a paid one (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Grok or OpenRouter).

## Always the right framing

Your video is wide and a short is tall. Shot by shot, the app decides what belongs in the frame.

### Follows the speaker

The frame stays on whoever is talking and cuts instantly when someone else speaks.

### Split screen

A quick back-and-forth shows both people (one on top, one below) for that part only.

### The whole person

Vlogs, walk-and-talks and sports keep the person head to toe. The frame moves with them, and with the ball after a shot.

### The whole picture

A title card, a leaderboard or two people far apart is shown whole on a soft background, so nothing you need to read or see is cut.

On **Auto (smart)** the app picks the framing for every shot. You can also choose **Follow speaker**, **Split screen** or **Full frame** in Settings. A face is never cut by the frame, the hook title or a scorecard.

## One video, every clip size

Choose the clip size on the CREATE tab before you press MAKE VIRAL CLIPS. The framing, the captions and the title are fitted to the size you pick.

### Shorts, Reels and TikTok

The tall size for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok and Stories.

### Instagram and Facebook feed

Takes more of the screen in the feed than a square post.

### Square posts

Works in every feed, and fits two speakers side by side.

### YouTube, X and LinkedIn

The wide size, for highlight clips on YouTube, X and LinkedIn.

Want the same moments in another size? Run the video again with a different size. The app remembers the clips it chose, so there is no AI wait.

## Complete guide

Everything you need, from installing the app to adding another AI key.

#### Install the app

1. Click **Download** at the top of this page. You get **ZenraAIViralClips.exe**.
2. Open it and click **Next** until **Finish**. No admin password is needed. Tick **Create a desktop shortcut** if you like.
3. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. New apps without a paid certificate show this once.
4. Open Zenra AI Viral Clips. Your 30-day free trial starts by itself (internet is needed the first time).

#### Get your free Groq key (2 minutes)

Groq is a free AI service. Its key lets the app write the words and run the AI editor, which gives the best results at no cost.

1. Open [console.groq.com/keys](https://console.groq.com/keys) and sign in with Google or email.
2. Click **Create API Key**, type any name and copy the key. It starts with **gsk_**.
3. In the app, open SETTINGS, then GROQ AI KEY, paste the key and press SAVE KEY.
4. Press TEST KEY. You should see **Key works**.

Your key is saved encrypted on your PC. Without a key the app still works offline, only slower and with simpler titles.

#### Make your first clips

1. On the CREATE tab, drag your video onto the window or click BROWSE (Ctrl + O). MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WEBM and most other video files work.
2. **Quality**: Original keeps your video's quality (a 4K video gives 4K clips). 4K, 2K and 1080p are there too.
3. **Clip length**: 15 sec, 30 sec, 45 sec, 1 min, 2 min or 3 min.
4. **Captions**: Viral Yellow, Green Pop, Zenra Cyan, Hormozi, Clean White, Karaoke, TikTok, Punch Words or Off. **Logo**: click Add logo and choose a PNG.
5. **Clip size**: 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, 4:5 for the Instagram and Facebook feed, 1:1 for a square post or 16:9 for YouTube, X and LinkedIn.
6. **Hook title on the clip**: Off, Big Title, Post Card or Black Box. It shows the clip's title at the top, like the header of a viral reel.
7. Press MAKE VIRAL CLIPS. Clips appear one by one with their title and viral score. STOP keeps every clip already made.

#### Find and post your clips

- Every clip card has PLAY, COPY TITLE (title and hashtags) and SHOW IN FOLDER.
- Clips are saved in **Downloads\Zenra AI Viral Clips\** in a folder named after your video, as **Title - 01.mp4**, **Title - 02.mp4** and so on. 01 is the best clip.
- The MY CLIPS tab keeps every video you've clipped, with OPEN FOLDER, COPY ALL TITLES and VIEW CLIPS.

#### Same clips again, or new ones

- The same video with the same clip length gives the same clips again, with no waiting for the AI. Use it to change the captions, logo, clip size or quality.
- After a run, press NEW CLIPS to get only moments you haven't made yet, never a repeat. When every good moment is used, the app tells you.

#### Settings explained

- **Framing**: Auto (smart), Follow speaker, Split screen or Full frame (no crop).
- **Number of clips**: Auto (every viral moment), or up to 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 50.
- **Video language**: Auto detect, or choose one of 13 languages.
- **Offline speech model**: used when there's no internet. Fast, Better or Best (slow).
- **Scorecards and score graphics**: On keeps a golf scorecard or score graphic on the clip when the picture is cropped.
- **Save clips to**: any folder you like.

#### Add another AI key, free or paid (optional)

The free Groq key is enough for most people. Settings has two more cards under it, one for free keys and one for paid keys. Only one key runs the AI editor at a time. Choose a company in one card and the other card switches to Off.

- **More free AI keys**: Google Gemini, Cerebras, Mistral or the free models on OpenRouter. No bank card is needed. Use one when the free Groq limit is reached, or to try another AI. A free key allows a set amount of work per minute, so a long video can take a little longer.
- **Paid AI keys**: OpenAI (ChatGPT), Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, xAI Grok or OpenRouter. The AI reads the whole video at once, so there is no free-limit waiting and the strongest models pick the clips. You pay the AI company directly, about 1 to 5 US cents per one-hour video.

1. In the app, open SETTINGS and go to MORE FREE AI KEYS or PAID AI KEYS.
2. Choose the AI company, then click **Get a key** to open its key page.
3. Paste your key and press SAVE KEY. It is tested automatically.
4. Leave the AI model on **Auto** (recommended).

The words (speech-to-text) still come from free Groq or the offline model. If your key runs out of credit or reaches its limit, the app switches back to Groq by itself, so your job never stops. Every key is saved encrypted on your PC.

#### Updates

The app updates itself. When a new version is ready you see a popup. One click, and it installs and reopens. You can also check at any time in SETTINGS with CHECK FOR UPDATES.

#### Fix common problems

- **“Windows protected your PC”**: click More info, then Run anyway.
- **“Groq key not accepted”**: make a new key at console.groq.com/keys, paste it, press SAVE KEY, then TEST KEY.
- **Clips are slow**: choose 1080p quality, or set the offline speech model to Fast.
- **Free Groq limit reached**: the app moves to another model by itself. For many long videos a day, add a second free key or a paid key in Settings.
- **Something went wrong**: press COPY DETAILS in the message and send it to us on WhatsApp. In SETTINGS, OPEN LOGS (FOR SUPPORT) opens the folder with the app's log file. It records what the app did, never your keys, and helps us find a problem fast.

Title: AI Agent vs Chatbot, Key Differences Explained | Zenra AI
Description: A chatbot answers questions. An AI agent also takes actions in your apps. Learn how they differ, what each costs to run and how to choose for your business.

AI

# AI agent vs chatbot and which one your business needs

Both talk to your customers. The difference is what happens after the answer, and that decides which one your business needs.

Published

November 3, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

4 min read

Zenra AI

Chatbots and AI agents both use AI models, and both can hold a conversation. The difference is what they are allowed to do. A chatbot answers. An AI agent can also **act**. It can look things up in your systems, update records and complete a task from start to finish.

This guide explains the difference in plain terms, shows when each one is the right choice, and lists the questions to ask before you build either.

## The short answer

- A **chatbot** answers questions from the information you give it, such as your FAQs, policies, product details or documents.
- An **AI agent** works through a task step by step and uses tools to get it done. For example, it reads a customer's message, checks the order in your store and replies with the real delivery status.
- **Automation** (tools like Zapier or n8n) runs fixed steps between apps. It is reliable for predictable work but can't handle situations nobody wrote a rule for.

## Side-by-side comparison

| Compared | Chatbot | AI agent |
|---|---|---|
| What it does | Answers questions | Answers and takes actions |
| Uses your apps | Rarely | Yes, your store, CRM, email, calendar and databases |
| Handles new situations | Within its knowledge | Yes, within the limits you set |
| Needs approval rules | Not usually | Yes, for anything important |
| Best for | FAQs and simple support | Varied work that needs judgment |

## When a chatbot is enough

A chatbot is the right choice when people mostly need information, not action:

- Opening hours, prices, policies and product details.
- Questions answered by your help center or documents.
- Guiding visitors to the right page or the right person.

It's quick to build, cheap to run and easy to keep accurate. A good chatbot shows where each answer came from and hands the conversation to a person when it isn't sure. A ready-made option is [Zenra AI Agent](https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/), which answers from your own information and passes chats to your team.

## When you need an AI agent

You need an agent when the answer depends on live data or the job isn't finished until something is done:

- **Customer support:** "Where is my order?", returns, changes and refunds that need a look at the order first.
- **Sales:** replying to new leads in seconds, asking qualifying questions and booking calls into your calendar.
- **Operations:** reading invoices, orders and forms and entering the data into your systems.
- **Reporting:** collecting numbers from several tools and writing the weekly summary.

If your team copies information between inboxes, apps and spreadsheets all day, that is usually the first job worth giving an agent.

## How to keep an AI agent safe

Because an agent can act, it needs clear limits. A well-built agent has:

- **Least-privilege access.** Only the tools and data its job needs, with keys you can revoke.
- **Approval for important actions.** Refunds, payments or messages to many customers wait for a person.
- **Human handoff.** Uncertain cases go to your team, with the context to decide quickly.
- **Logs** of what it read, decided and did, so every step can be checked.
- **Testing on real cases** from your business, including the tricky ones, before it goes live.

## What it costs to run

Both run on AI models that are billed by usage, so the monthly cost grows with the number of conversations and tasks. A chatbot usually costs less per conversation because it does fewer steps. An agent costs more per task but replaces more work. A good developer estimates the running cost before launch and keeps it low with the right-sized model for each step.

## A quick checklist to help you choose

- If the answer depends on live data in your systems, choose an **agent**.
- If the job ends with an action, like an update, a booking or a refund, choose an **agent**.
- If the questions are answered by documents that rarely change, a **chatbot** is enough.
- If you want to start small and prove the value first, start with a **chatbot or a one-task agent pilot**, then grow it.

Not sure which you need? [Tell us about the task](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=ai-agents) and we'll recommend the simplest option that works, whether that is a chatbot, an agent or plain automation.

Description: Desktop app or web app? Compare speed, offline use, updates, cost and reach, see real examples and find out which one fits your users and your budget best.

Apps

# Desktop app vs web app and which one your business should build

A web app runs in the browser. A desktop app is installed on Windows or Mac. Here's how to choose, from a team that builds and runs both.

Published

November 3, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

4 min read

Zenra AI

A **web app** is software people use in their browser, such as a client portal, a booking system or a dashboard. A **desktop app** is installed on a Windows or Mac computer and runs on that machine. Both can look modern and both can connect to the same online services. What differs is where the work happens.

## The short answer

- Build a **web app** when many people need access from anywhere, on any device, with nothing to install.
- Build a **desktop app** when the work is heavy (video, large files, AI on the device) when it must work offline, or when it needs the computer's own hardware.

## Side-by-side comparison

| Compared | Web app | Desktop app |
|---|---|---|
| Where it runs | In the browser | On the user's computer |
| Installation | None, just open a link | An installer, once |
| Works offline | Limited | Yes |
| Heavy work | Done on your servers | Done on the user's computer |
| Updates | Instant for everyone | Automatic updates, built in |
| Reach | Any device with a browser | Windows and Mac computers |

## When a web app is the better choice

- Your customers or staff log in from many devices, including phones.
- The app is mostly forms, records and dashboards.
- Data must be shared live between many users.

Customer portals, booking systems and dashboards usually fit here. See how we build them in [custom web development](https://zenraai.com/services/custom-web-development/).

## When a desktop app is the better choice

- **Heavy processing:** editing or rendering video, handling large files or running AI on the device.
- **Offline work:** the app must keep working without a stable connection.
- **Privacy:** files should stay on the user's computer instead of being uploaded.
- **Hardware access:** the app uses the GPU, local folders or connected devices.

Our own apps are examples. [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/) renders 4K clips on the user's own PC, so their video is never uploaded. [Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/) saves large files straight to the computer, several at a time.

## Can you have both?

Yes, and many products do. A shared backend can serve a web app, a desktop app and a mobile app at once. Some desktop apps are even built with web technology (Electron or Tauri), so much of the code is shared. A common path is to start with the version your users need most, then add the other once it proves itself.

## What a proper desktop app needs

A desktop app is more than its screens. Before launch, plan for:

- A proper installer, with shortcuts and a clean uninstall.
- Code signing where the platform requires it, so it opens without warnings.
- Automatic updates, so every user stays on the latest version.
- Licensing and payments, if you sell it.
- Crash and error reporting, so problems are fixed fast.

Planning an app? [Tell us who will use it and on which devices](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=apps). We'll recommend web, desktop, mobile or a mix, and build it in days.

E-commerce

# E-commerce website vs Facebook page for selling online

Selling through social media is a great start. Here's how it compares with your own online store, and the signs it's time to build one.

Published

September 25, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

3 min read

Zenra AI

Many businesses start selling through a Facebook page, an Instagram profile or direct messages. It's free, fast and puts products in front of people who already follow you. But as orders grow, taking payments in chat, tracking stock in your head and relying on the algorithm starts to hold the business back.

Here's an honest comparison, and the signs it's time to open your own store.

## Selling through a Facebook or Instagram page

**What works well:**

- No setup cost, and you can start today.
- Your audience is already there.
- Conversations build trust, especially for new brands.

**Where it struggles:**

- Orders arrive in messages and have to be handled one by one.
- No real checkout, so payments, addresses and confirmations are manual.
- Reach depends on an algorithm you don't control.
- Little data about who buys and why, which makes ads harder to optimize.
- The platform owns the relationship with your customers.

## Selling through your own online store

**What works well:**

- Customers can buy at any hour without waiting for a reply.
- Card and wallet payments, shipping rates and order emails are automatic.
- Product pages can rank in search engines and bring free traffic.
- You own your customer list and can email past buyers.
- Accurate tracking makes every advertising dollar easier to measure.

**What to plan for:**

- A setup cost and usually a monthly platform fee.
- Someone has to keep products, prices and apps up to date.
- A store still needs traffic, so social media and ads remain important.

## Side-by-side comparison

| Compared | Facebook or Instagram page | Your own online store |
|---|---|---|
| Cost to start | Free | Setup plus monthly fees |
| Checkout and payments | Manual, in messages | Automatic, 24/7 |
| Search engine traffic | Minimal | Yes, from product pages |
| Customer data | Owned by the platform | Yours |
| Ad tracking | Limited | Full conversion tracking |
| Scales with orders | Hard | Easily |

## Signs it's time to build a store

- You spend hours a day answering “price?” and taking orders in messages.
- Orders get lost, duplicated or delayed.
- Customers ask to pay by card or want an order confirmation.
- You're running ads and can't tell which ones bring sales.
- You have more than twenty or so products, or several variants per product.
- You want to sell beyond your local area.

## You don't have to choose

The strongest setup uses both. Social media brings discovery and conversation, and the store handles checkout, payments and data. Link your social profiles to your store, and every post can send people to a product page that's ready to sell.

## How to get started

1. **Choose a platform.** Shopify is the easiest to run. WooCommerce gives more control if you already use WordPress.
2. **Set up the essentials.** Payments, shipping zones, taxes, and clear policy pages for shipping, returns and privacy.
3. **Make great product pages.** Good photos, honest descriptions, sizes and delivery times.
4. **Add tracking.** Google Analytics 4 from day one, so you can see which channels bring sales.
5. **Connect your social channels** so followers can shop in a tap.

Want a store that's built to sell and managed for you, so you can focus on the business? See our [e-commerce development service](https://zenraai.com/services/ecommerce-development/).

# How to download videos on a PC in HD and 4K (2026 guide)

A step-by-step guide to saving videos, playlists and audio on Windows in the quality you want, and how to do it responsibly.

Published

September 25, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

3 min read

Zenra AI

Saving a video to your computer is useful for editing, presenting offline, archiving your own content or watching on a slow connection. This guide shows how to download videos, whole playlists and audio on a Windows PC in the quality you want, using [Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/).

Download responsibly.

Only download content you own, have permission to use, or that the platform allows you to save, and follow each platform's terms.

## What you need

- A Windows 10 or Windows 11 PC.
- Zenra Video Downloader, where every new PC gets a 1-day free trial with full access.
- The link to the video, playlist or channel.

## Step by step

1. **Install the app.** Download it from the [product page](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/), open the installer and follow the steps. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. New apps without a paid certificate show this once.
2. **Copy the link.** Open the video in your browser or app and copy its address. It works with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Snapchat and many other sites.
3. **Paste it into the app.** Paste one link, or several links at once for a batch.
4. **Choose the quality.** Pick 4K, 1440p, 1080p or MP3 audio, or choose Best quality to get the highest version available.
5. **Download.** Downloads run side by side, up to five at a time. When a file is ready, click Open to go straight to it.

## Download a whole playlist or channel

Paste a playlist or channel link instead of a single video. The app saves every video into its own folder, so a course, a series or a creator's Shorts stay organized. You can pause the batch and resume it later.

## Getting the best quality

- **Best quality** automatically picks the highest resolution the video offers.
- **4K needs a 4K source.** If the original was uploaded in 1080p, that's the highest quality available.
- **Higher quality means bigger files.** A few minutes of 4K video can take several hundred megabytes.
- **MP3** saves just the audio, which is handy for podcasts, lectures and music you have rights to.

## Troubleshooting

- **A site stopped working.** Websites change often. Use the one-click engine update in the app to get the latest fixes.
- **Downloads are slow.** Run fewer downloads at the same time, or check your connection.
- **A video won't download.** Private, members-only and paid videos can't be downloaded.
- **A download failed.** Open your history and press Retry.

## Download responsibly

Downloading is a convenience, not a license to reuse other people's work. Keep downloads for personal use unless you have permission, credit creators, and never re-upload content you don't own. If you're saving your own videos for editing, for example to turn a long video into short clips, you're in the clear.

Ready to try it? [Get Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/) and use every feature free for a full day.

Description: Shopify or WooCommerce? A plain comparison of costs, ease of use, control, payments and growth, plus a simple way to decide which fits your online store.

E-commerce

# Shopify vs WooCommerce and which is better for your online store

Both run millions of stores. The right one depends on how much control you want, who will run the store, and how fast you need to start selling.

Published

November 3, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

4 min read

Zenra AI

Shopify and WooCommerce are the two most popular ways to build an online store. They solve the same problem in different ways. **Shopify** is a hosted platform you subscribe to, and hosting, security and updates are handled for you. **WooCommerce** is a free plugin that turns a WordPress website into a store you host and control yourself.

## The short answer

- Choose **Shopify** if you want to start selling fast, with the least technical upkeep.
- Choose **WooCommerce** if you want full control over your store and data, already run a WordPress site, or need features a hosted platform can't offer.

## Side-by-side comparison

| Compared | Shopify | WooCommerce |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | An all-in-one, hosted store platform | A free plugin for WordPress |
| Hosting and security | Included and handled by Shopify | Your own hosting, kept updated by you or your developer |
| Running costs | A monthly plan, plus paid apps and payment fees | Hosting and domain, plus paid extensions and payment fees |
| Ease of use | The easiest to run day to day | Flexible, with a little more upkeep |
| Design and features | Themes and a large app store | Themes, plugins and full access to the code |
| Payments | Shopify Payments where available, or other gateways | Stripe, PayPal and many local gateways through extensions |

## When Shopify is the better choice

- You want a professional store live quickly and don't want to manage hosting or updates.
- Your team isn't technical and needs a simple admin for products, orders and discounts.
- You expect to grow fast and want the platform to handle traffic spikes for you.

## When WooCommerce is the better choice

- You already have a WordPress website with content that ranks, and want the store on the same site.
- You want full ownership of the code, the data and the hosting.
- You need custom features, product types or checkout rules that a hosted platform makes difficult.

## What about costs?

Neither is free once you start selling. With Shopify you pay a monthly plan, any paid apps and payment processing fees. With WooCommerce the plugin is free, but you pay for hosting, a domain, any paid extensions and payment processing fees, and someone has to keep it updated. Both change their prices from time to time, so check the current plans on [Shopify's pricing page](https://www.shopify.com/pricing) and [WooCommerce.com](https://woocommerce.com/) before you decide.

## Can you switch later?

Yes. Products, customers and orders can be moved from one platform to the other. The important part is protecting your search rankings, so keep or redirect every old URL and carry over titles and descriptions. Done carefully, customers and search engines barely notice the move.

## How to decide in five minutes

- Who will run the store every day? You, a non-technical team or a developer?
- Do you already have a WordPress site worth keeping?
- Do you need anything unusual, like custom product options, bookings, subscriptions or special checkout rules?
- Which payment methods do your customers use, and are they available on each platform in your country?

Still unsure? [Tell us what you sell and where](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=ecommerce). We'll recommend the platform that fits and build the store in days.

## Sources

- [Shopify pricing](https://www.shopify.com/pricing), Shopify
- [WooCommerce](https://woocommerce.com/), Automattic

Video

# How to split a long video for WhatsApp Status on a PC (free)

Post a long video to your Status in parts, in the right order and in original quality, without cutting a word in half.

Published

November 3, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

3 min read

Zenra AI

WhatsApp Status plays each video only up to a set length, so a longer video has to be posted in parts. Cutting it by hand in an editor is slow, the parts come out uneven, and a cut often lands in the middle of a word.

This guide shows how to split any video into equal parts on a Windows PC in a few seconds, free, using [Zenra Video Splitter](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/). The same steps work for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.

## What you need

- A Windows 10 or Windows 11 PC (64-bit).
- Zenra Video Splitter, which is free, with no watermark and no sign-up.
- Your video. MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WEBM and most other video files work.

## Step by step

1. **Install the app.** Download it from the [product page](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/) and run the installer. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. New apps without a paid certificate show this once.
2. **Select your video.** Click Browse, or drag the video onto the app.
3. **Type the number of clips.** The app shows how long each clip will be, so you can pick a number that fits your Status.
4. **Choose a folder.** Your video's folder is filled in for you. The clips are saved in a new folder named after the video.
5. **Press Split Video.** A 20-minute video splits into 20 clips in a few seconds. Click Open Folder to see them.

## How many parts should you use?

Divide the length of your video by the longest clip your Status allows, and round up. For example, a 10-minute video with a one-minute limit needs at least 10 parts.

When your clips come out close to a 60- or 90-second limit, or 3 minutes for Shorts and Reels, the splitter makes sure no clip goes over it, so WhatsApp never trims the end of a part.

## Why the quality stays the same

Most video splitters re-encode the whole video, which takes time and softens the picture. Zenra Video Splitter copies the clips straight from your original file in most cases, so they look exactly like it. Only when a video's structure needs it are a few frames at a cut re-encoded, at very high quality.

It also moves each cut to a natural pause, so nobody's sentence is cut in half between two parts.

## Post the parts in order

- Move the clips to your phone with a USB cable or the cloud folder you already use.
- Post part 1 first. Status shows updates in the order you post them.
- Make the first part strong, because it decides whether people keep watching.

Everything happens on your PC. Nothing is uploaded, and there's no watermark on your clips.

## Want clips that pick themselves?

Splitting gives you equal parts. If you'd rather post only the best moments (with captions, titles and the speaker kept in frame) [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/) finds them for you. Read [how to turn one long video into 30 short clips](https://zenraai.com/blog/turn-long-videos-into-short-clips/).

# How to turn one long video into 30 short clips

A practical workflow for turning podcasts, interviews and vlogs into Shorts, Reels and TikToks, what makes a clip work and how to do it in hours, not days.

Published

October 21, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

4 min read

Zenra AI

A one-hour podcast, interview or webinar is the most efficient content most creators and businesses ever make. The problem is that very few people watch an hour of anything from someone they don't know yet. Short vertical clips are how new viewers find you, and a single long video can feed YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok for weeks.

This guide covers what makes a short clip work, the manual workflow editors use, and a faster way to do the same job with AI.

## Why clips from long videos work

Short-form feeds reward frequency and strong openings. Long-form content is where trust is built. Clipping connects the two. Each short introduces one idea, and the people who like it go looking for the full conversation. You aren't inventing new content every day. You're putting the best moments of work you've already done in front of more people.

- **You already have the material.** One recording can produce dozens of posts.
- **You can post consistently.** A backlog of clips makes a daily schedule realistic.
- **You learn what lands.** Each clip tests a different idea, hook or guest.

## What makes a short clip work

The best clips share four things, whatever the topic:

1. **A hook in the first two seconds.** A question, a bold claim, a surprising number or a strong reaction. If the clip starts with “so, um, anyway”, most viewers are gone.
2. **One complete idea.** A setup and a payoff. The clip should end when the point lands, not mid-sentence and not half a minute later.
3. **The speaker in frame.** In a 9:16 crop of a wide video, the person talking has to stay centered, and when two people go back and forth, viewers want to see both.
4. **Readable captions.** Many people scroll with the sound off. Big, high-contrast captions that highlight each word as it's spoken keep them watching.

Length matters less than completeness. Fifteen to sixty seconds is ideal for discovery, and up to three minutes works when the story needs it.

## The manual workflow (and why it takes so long)

Here's how an editor usually clips a long video by hand:

1. Watch or transcribe the whole video.
2. Mark every moment with a strong hook and a clear payoff.
3. Cut each clip so it starts and ends cleanly.
4. Reframe it to 9:16 and keep the active speaker in the shot, cut by cut.
5. Add word-by-word captions and fix the transcript errors.
6. Write a title and hashtags, export, and name the files.

For a one-hour video and twenty or thirty clips, that's easily a full working day, often more. It's why many teams post far less than they could.

## The faster workflow with AI

Modern tools can do most of those steps automatically. Our own app, [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/), was built for exactly this job on Windows:

1. **Add your video.** Drag it onto the app. Long videos are welcome, and longer videos give more clips.
2. **Pick your style.** Quality up to 4K, clip length from 15 seconds to 3 minutes, one of eight caption styles and your logo.
3. **Make the clips.** The AI transcribes the video, finds the strongest moments, frames the speaker (with a split screen for back-and-forth conversations) and adds captions and titles.
4. **Review and post.** Clips are ranked, so start with #01. One click copies the title and hashtags.

Your video is processed on your own PC, and there's no watermark. The app comes with a 30-day free trial.

## How many clips can one video give you?

It depends on how dense the conversation is, but as a guide, a one-hour podcast gives about thirty clips of 15 seconds, or about ten clips of three minutes. Interviews and panels with lots of back-and-forth usually give more strong moments than a scripted talk.

## Tips for posting your clips

- **Lead with your best.** Post the strongest clip first, because it sets how the platform judges the next ones.
- **Test hooks.** The same moment with a different first line can perform very differently.
- **Keep a steady schedule.** One or two clips a day beats ten in one afternoon.
- **Post everywhere.** The same vertical clip works on Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
- **Watch retention, not just views.** The share of people who watch to the end tells you which ideas to make more of.

## Quick checklist

- Hook in the first two seconds
- One complete idea, clean start and end
- Speaker centered and both people visible in conversations
- Word-by-word captions, easy to read on a phone
- Clear title, a few relevant hashtags, your logo

Need a custom video pipeline for your brand or platform? We build those too. See [custom AI development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-tool-development/).

## Sources

- [Instagram officially expands Reels length to 3 minutes](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/instagram-officially-expands-reels-length-to-3-minutes/737766/), Social Media Today

AI

# What is AI tool development? 5 ways custom AI tools help small businesses

What custom AI tools are, where they save real time and money, and how to start a first project without wasting budget.

Published

September 25, 2026

Updated

November 12, 2026

3 min read

Zenra AI

AI tool development means building software that uses AI models to do a specific job inside your business, such as answering questions from your own documents, turning invoices into data, drafting replies or adding smart search to your product. It's different from subscribing to a general chatbot, because a custom tool fits your workflow, connects to your systems and belongs to you.

This article explains what that looks like in practice, five places it pays off for small businesses, and how to start without wasting budget.

## What counts as an AI tool?

Most useful business AI tools fall into a handful of patterns:

- **Assistants** that answer customer or staff questions from your own content.
- **Document processing** that reads forms, invoices, contracts or emails and extracts the fields you need.
- **Workflow automation** where AI handles the steps between apps, such as sorting, summarizing, drafting and routing.
- **Content tools** that help produce product descriptions, reports or short video clips faster.
- **AI features** inside an existing website or app, such as search, summaries or recommendations.

## Off-the-shelf or custom?

Ready-made AI products are a great place to start. Custom tools make sense when the task is specific to your business or touches your own systems. When the tool also has to take actions across your apps, you are looking at an [AI agent](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-agent-development/).

| Compared | Off-the-shelf AI app | Custom AI tool |
|---|---|---|
| Speed to start | Minutes | A few days |
| Fit to your workflow | Generic | Built around it |
| Connects to your systems | Limited | Yes, through APIs |
| Data and ownership | Stays on their platform | In your accounts |
| Cost model | Per-seat subscription | Build cost plus usage |

## 5 ways custom AI tools help small businesses

### 1. Answer customer questions instantly

An assistant trained on your website, policies and product details can answer common questions at any hour, show where the answer came from, and hand the conversation to a person when it should. **Measure:** response time, share of questions resolved without a person, customer satisfaction.

### 2. Turn documents into data

Instead of typing invoice totals, order details or form fields by hand, a tool can read the document, extract the data and send it to your accounting or CRM system, flagging anything it isn't sure about. **Measure:** hours saved per week, error rate.

### 3. Automate the steps between apps

Many jobs are a chain. An email arrives, someone reads it, updates a spreadsheet and creates a task. AI can handle the reading and deciding, and automation handles the rest. **Measure:** turnaround time, items handled per day.

### 4. Create content faster

Draft product descriptions in your brand voice, summarize long reports or turn a long video into short clips with captions, which is the approach behind our own app, [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/). People stay in charge of the final version. **Measure:** time per piece, output per week.

### 5. Get answers from your own data

Ask questions in plain language across your documents, tickets or sales notes, and get summaries and reports without digging. **Measure:** time to find information, decisions made with data.

## How to start without wasting budget

1. **Pick one repetitive task** that takes real time every week.
2. **Measure it today.** How long it takes and what mistakes cost.
3. **Prototype on real examples** before building the full tool.
4. **Keep a person in the loop** for anything that affects customers or money.
5. **Estimate running costs** per task, not just the build cost.

## What does it cost?

Cost has two parts, building the tool and running it. Build cost depends on the number of steps, integrations and screens. Running cost depends on how often the AI is used and which model does the work. For many business tasks it's a few cents per task or less, and smart caching and model choice keep it predictable. A small prototype is the cheapest way to find out whether the full build is worth it.

## Questions to ask an AI developer

- How will our data be stored, and is it used to train anyone's models?
- Which model will you use, and can it be changed later?
- How will we know when the AI is wrong, and what happens then?
- Who owns the code and the AI accounts?
- What will it cost to run each month?

Thinking about a first AI project? [Tell us about the task](https://zenraai.com/contact/?service=ai-tools) and we'll suggest the simplest version worth building.
